xxxxkillroyxxxx.text: Since 2013, xxxxKILLROYxxxx has been the matchup board's quiet surprise: mid-pack overall, yet the matchup kill-death line sits near the top. The lifetime board tells the opposite story, which makes this one a puzzle worth a second look. Patient, unflustered when the opposition stiffens, and still showing up after all these years.

xmakeplanetsidegreatagain.text: XMakePlanetsideGreatAgain plays the game at full throttle: among the very best tracked, scorching tempo behind it, turning it up against stronger opposition. Lifetime and matchup figures paint one picture, and the strongest-third share sits in the middle. A fast, complete game from top to bottom.

xzyr0s.text: xZyr0s plays at a blistering pace: among the very best tracked, with the fastest trigger work on the board, pouring it on as the opposition improves. The toughest-opposition edge stays high, and the matchup kill-death tally sits near the top. Speed with substance, and plenty of both.

xizhenqing.text: XiZhenQing fights with total command: among the fiercest competitors in the game, standing at the very top, and unshakable against the toughest fights. The edge endures against the hardest third too, which crowns a complete card. Take this one as a rough sketch: the opponent pool behind it is older and smaller.

xstargonx.text: Since 2015, XStargonX has played the long, deliberate game: keeping a place near the very top, composed under the toughest pressure. Solid against the hardest opposition. Headshots are rare here, and the lifetime IvI sits below the middle, so the matchups give the honest picture. A veteran who still shows up and still delivers.

xinpanzee.text: XinPanZee plays a sharp, complete game: top shelf across the whole card, with the keenest aim in the ledger and a lifetime IvI among the elite. The trigger keeps a brisk clip, and the bite holds as the bar rises. Read this one as an early sketch — built on an older, smaller sample, and the portrait is still filling in.

xmasterbobxx.text: Since 2014, xMasterBobxx has played the same relentless game: near the top of the matchups, steady under heavier pressure, and headshots landing near the summit. The consistency line is the one mid-pack entry on an otherwise upper-tier card, which keeps the story honest. The lifetime ledger and the matchups agree with each other, which leaves little room for argument.

xcoooooooooooooooooooooolproairx.text: xCOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOLPROAIRx breaks the mold: matchup rating, activity, and resistance all near the top, with accuracy to match and a lifetime kill-death board at the very peak. The headshot share sits near the bottom, and the lifetime IvI lands near the bottom too — the matchups see a far stronger player than the lifetime board does. A reminder that the card rewards what happens in real fights, not the long-run ledger.

xxheadhunterzsxx.text: xxHeadhunterzsxx keeps the pressure on: the rating runs high, the tempo stays fierce, the courage holds, the staying power holds steady. The matchup kill-death mark backs it up. The pace sits above average, accuracy too, and headshots land more often than most. The lifetime IvI lands above average as well, and consistency holds above average — a card with no weak line at all.

xiayacao.text: xiayacao is a surgeon: accuracy among the very best tracked, and the matchup kill-death figure right beside it, and resistance that barely bends. The game thins out fast against stronger enemies, and the edge drops further against the hardest third, so the duels are chosen, not chased. Headshots are rare and the lifetime board puts them near the bottom, yet the matchups tell a different story entirely.

xrobin7nc.text: xRobin7nc plays a polished, high-volume game: elite on nearly every line, with pace at the very top and a game that rises with the opposition. The aim is precise, headshots make up a strong share, and the lifetime IvI lands near the summit. Consistency rests mid-pack, the one blemish on an otherwise strong card.

xxtr1plehxx.text: xXTR1PLEHXx plays a sharp, disciplined game: rating, tempo, resistance — all in the upper tier, with bravery a step back, the matchup kill-death mark riding up near the top. Mid-pack accuracy and headshot share do not dent the card — the wins come from timing and nerve. The lifetime IvI settles mid-pack, so the matchups rate this veteran higher than the lifetime board does.
